name: Bulky
description:
Bulky is a simple and powerful bulk file and folder renaming utility developed for the XApps project by the Linux Mint team. It allows users to rename multiple files simultaneously using a variety of pattern matching and substitution rules.

Features:
- Find and replace text within filenames with regular expression support
- Add prefixes, suffixes, or insert text at specific character positions
- Modify text case including uppercase, lowercase, title case, and camel case
- Sequential numbering with customizable starting points and step increments
- Instant live preview of proposed name changes before applying them to disk
